narr: The remnant circulation of former Pacific Hurricane Kay brought thunderstorms and flash flooding to the Mojave Desert.
ev: The Archibald Wash flooded Pierce Ferry Rd.
Several roads were closed, and a swift water rescue was performed on Oatman Highway.
Burro Creek Crossing Rd was closed.
Eight water rescues occurred, five to ten homes had water in them, and an observer measured 3.86 inches of rain in just under two hours.
Numerous roads in and near Golden Valley were closed.
